title: Branches
description: Copies of this database for testing and previews, with their own credentials.
empty: This database has no branches yet. Create one to try changes safely.
unavailable: Branches are not available on this server yet. They arrive after the next update.
notReady: This branch is not ready yet. Try again when the copy finishes.

create.title: Create a branch
create.description: Copies the data you choose into a new database.
create.name: Name

reset.title: Reset this branch
reset.body: Replaces {{name}} with a fresh copy of its parent. Its data and credentials change.

promote.title: Promote this branch
promote.body: Makes {{name}} the main database. This cannot be undone.
